commands.name: meter
commands.description: Show or hide the usage pills above the prompt
commands.output: Usage pills hidden. /meter brings them back.

commands.name: snippets
commands.description: List prompt snippets (;name), or save one: /snippets add <name> <text>
commands.output:
No snippets yet. Save one with:
  /snippets add review Review my uncommitted changes for bugs
or put Markdown files in ~/.claude/snippets (or a project's .claude/snippets).
Then type ;review anywhere in a prompt.
